Requirement (short): Register with name, email/phone and password
Comments: Automated registration and bcrypt-hash assertions passed in backend CI.

Requirement (short): Authenticate registered users and issue JWT
Comments: JWT creation and invalid credentials are covered by automated tests.

Requirement (short): Reset password using a time-limited OTP
Comments: OTP expiry, one-time use, hash storage and generic response tested; real relay configuration remains deployment-specific.

Requirement (short): Lock account after five consecutive failed logins
Comments: Automated 5-failure and 15-minute lock behaviour passed.

Requirement (short): Provide role-based login and protected functions
Comments: Driver/admin/attendant authorization paths have automated role checks.

Requirement (short): Display selected-lot slot availability
Comments: API and board tests exist; multi-worker/deployed event delivery is not fully accepted.

Requirement (short): Search lots by location, price and availability
Comments: Search filters and distance sorting have automated coverage.

Requirement (short): Reserve a slot for a selected time window
Comments: Normal booking path is tested; stale-lock owner fencing remains a known failed fault-injection condition.

Requirement (short): Cancel an eligible reservation
Comments: Cancellation path is covered; refund/provider deployment acceptance remains pending.

Requirement (short): Prevent overlapping reservations / double booking
Comments: Ordinary parallel booking test passes; stale-owner fencing is not proven and has a recorded failure.

Requirement (short): Record authorized vehicle entry
Comments: Entry API path is tested; audit atomicity / notification durability remains an open consistency concern.

Requirement (short): Record vehicle exit and stay duration
Comments: Exit, slot release and duration are covered; side-effect consistency remains unaccepted.

Requirement (short): Accept simulated ANPR entry/exit events
Comments: Simulated scan path is exercised through shared entry/exit logic.

Requirement (short): Validate vehicle against active reservation
Comments: Vehicle/reservation match and mismatch responses are tested.

Requirement (short): Raise and retrieve unauthorized-vehicle alerts
Comments: Alert persistence, type and newest-first listing are tested.

Requirement (short): Publish current slot status to the availability board
Comments: In-process event and frontend coverage exists; cross-worker event loss is documented as possible during relay outages.

Requirement (short): Calculate parking fees using duration and saved tariff
Comments: Fee calculations and saved pricing estimate paths are tested.

Requirement (short): Charge through a tokenized sandbox gateway
Comments: Mocked/service contract checks pass; live Stripe test-account transaction remains to be recorded.

Requirement (short): Provide receipts and cancellation refunds
Comments: Scenario automation exists; live Stripe refund acceptance and deployment evidence remain pending.

Requirement (short): Create/update/deactivate lots and manage slots
Comments: Lot CRUD and bulk slot creation are covered by automated API tests.

Requirement (short): Configure hourly and peak pricing rules
Comments: Positive rates, peak rules and invalid inputs are covered.

Requirement (short): Provide occupancy counts for administrators
Comments: Occupancy aggregation is compared with slot records in automated tests.

Requirement (short): Create and list parking attendant accounts
Comments: Role restriction and password hashing are tested.

Requirement (short): Notify users of booking confirmation
Comments: Durable booking marker/reconciliation is tested; actual provider delivery is not configured.

Requirement (short): Notify users of entry, exit and payment events
Comments: Retry/idempotency path is tested; event enqueue is not atomic with entry/exit/payment writes.

Requirement (short): Generate occupancy and revenue reports
Comments: Endpoint exists; dedicated date-range accuracy and report acceptance test evidence is not yet recorded.

Requirement (short): 90th-percentile response time no more than 3 seconds
Comments: Some 500-user local JMeter runs measured p90 under 3 seconds with a test-only keep-alive override; representative deployment acceptance is outstanding.

Requirement (short): Monthly service availability at least 99.5%
Comments: No monthly uptime period or monitoring evidence is available.

Requirement (short): Support 500 concurrent users within performance target
Comments: Local 500-user runs exist and are variable; the final representative deployment test has not been accepted.

Requirement (short): Do not store raw card data; protect sensitive data
Comments: Token-based interface and allowlisted persistence are implemented; live provider/security review evidence remains incomplete.

Requirement (short): Provide applicable WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
Comments: UI tests exist; a formal axe/screen-reader/keyboard accessibility audit is not recorded.

Requirement (short): Enforce TLS 1.2+ for network connections
Comments: Nginx config syntax test passes with an ephemeral certificate; real hostname, trust chain and handshake checks remain pending.

Requirement (short): Store passwords as salted one-way hashes
Comments: bcrypt hash assertions pass; plaintext password is not returned.

Requirement (short): Enforce role-based access control
Comments: Wrong-role 403 and authentication checks are automated.

Requirement (short): Delegate card processing to tokenized gateway; never persist card data
Comments: Application accepts provider token, not PAN; live Stripe browser transaction and complete deployment validation remain pending.

Requirement (short): Maintain auditable admin actions with actor and timestamp
Comments: Success-path audit assertions exist, but fault injection shows the lot mutation can persist if AuditLog.create fails. Not remediated in this documentation task.
